How confidence is setIt follows the kind of evidence, not judgement.
  • The customer's own statement (high confidence at most): The organisation says so itself: its press release, website, annual report or a named executive on the record.
  • Regulatory or securities filing (high confidence at most): A filing by the customer or the vendor names the relationship.
  • Independent press (high confidence at most): Editorially independent reporting describes the deployment.
  • Joint announcement (medium confidence at most): A press release issued with the vendor, usually with a quote from the customer.
  • Vendor case study (medium confidence at most): The vendor's published customer story naming the organisation.
  • Vendor mention only (low confidence at most): A logo, a customer list or a passing mention by the vendor, with nothing from the customer.
  • An organisation that also holds a stake in the vendor is labelled “Investor and customer” and is never rated above medium.
  • A partnership is listed as a partner, not a customer.

Reputation

Adverse items are attributed to their sources and need one primary source or two independent ones before they are published.

Reputation
Regulatory actionsCisco disclosed in its Form 10-K for fiscal 2026 that Brazilian authorities have investigated its Brazilian subsidiary and certain former employees over alleged evasion of import taxes, and that Brazilian federal and Sao Paulo state tax authorities have asserted claims for calendar years 2004 to 2007 that total US$153 million in tax, US$969 million in interest and US$315 million in penalties. Cisco stated that it believes the claims are without merit, is defending them, and does not expect a final judicial determination for several years. No enforcement action against Cisco was found in the US FTC cases and proceedings library, the US SEC litigation releases and administrative proceedings lists, or the UK ICO enforcement list when searched on 2026-11-20. Questions to ask the vendor (4)

  1. Which shareholders hold more than 5% of Cisco's common stock according to its latest proxy statement?
    Large shareholders can influence strategy and are part of ownership due diligence.
  2. Have any significant customers stopped using Cisco AI Defense, and why?
    Loss of reference customers can signal product or service problems.
  3. Have there been any leadership departures, investigations or conduct issues at Cisco in the last two years that a customer should know about?
    Leadership conduct or instability is a reputational risk factor.
  4. What is the list price per AI application for each AI Defense package, and per usage block under committed usage?
    Without price points a bank cannot budget or compare suppliers.

Timeline

  1. 2026-11-09 · partnership Cisco Systems, Inc.
    Cisco says it will add Anthropic's Claude Mythos to AI Defense adaptive red teaming

    In a release dated 2026-11-09 Cisco said it is adding Anthropic's Claude Mythos model to the adaptive red-teaming framework in AI Defense, restricted to registered targets and authenticated operators, and described it as coming soon for select enterprises. The same release said AI Defense has been used by hundreds of customers since its January 2025 launch; no customers were named. Cisco Newsroom (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-20, opens in new tab)

  2. 2026-08-11 · certification Cisco Systems, Inc.
    Cisco says Secure Access for Government has reached FedRAMP Class D (High)

    Cisco stated in a post dated 2026-08-11 that Secure Access for Government, which received FedRAMP Class C (Moderate) in August 2025, had achieved FedRAMP Certified Class D (High), applied to existing subscriptions without customer action. The date is that of the post; the certification date was not given, and a FedRAMP Marketplace entry for the offering was not located on 2026-11-21. Cisco (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-21, opens in new tab)

  3. 2026-06-29 · acquisition Cisco Systems, Inc.
    Cisco completes acquisition of non-human identity specialist Astrix Security

    Cisco announced on 2026-05-04 that it intended to acquire Astrix Security, an Israeli company whose platform inventories AI agents, MCP servers and non-human identities and manages their access and lifecycle, and added an update dated 2026-06-29 stating that the acquisition had been completed. Cisco did not disclose the price; Calcalist reported about US$400 million and SiliconANGLE cited an earlier estimate of about US$300 million. Cisco said Astrix's capabilities would be integrated into Cisco Identity Intelligence and extended to Duo and Secure Access, and that existing Astrix customers should keep using their current support process. The Astrix website now redirects to Cisco Identity Intelligence. Astrix Security is not tracked as a separate vendor in this dataset.   4. 2026-05-22 · acquisition GalileoCisco Systems, Inc.
    Cisco completes acquisition of Galileo; product becomes Splunk Agent Observability

    Cisco announced on 2026-04-09 its intent to acquire Galileo Technologies, Inc., an AI evaluation and observability company, and added an update dated 2026-05-22 stating that the acquisition had been completed. Terms were not disclosed. Galileo's product is now sold as Splunk Agent Observability within Cisco's Splunk Observability portfolio, and the galileo.ai website redirects to splunk.com.     Cisco announces Duo Agentic Identity for registering and governing AI agents

    Cisco's Duo business announced Duo Agentic Identity, under which AI agents are registered in Duo Directory as non-human identities mapped to a human owner, discovered through Cisco Identity Intelligence, and governed through an MCP gateway that checks each tool call against Duo's authorisation policy. The announcement does not state whether the features were generally available. Cisco Duo (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-21, opens in new tab)Cisco Duo (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-21, opens in new tab)

  6. 2026-03-23 · launch Cisco Systems, Inc.
    Cisco launches self-serve AI Defense: Explorer Edition and an Agent Runtime SDK

    At RSA Conference on 2026-03-23 Cisco announced AI Defense: Explorer Edition, a self-serve red-teaming tool that Cisco says uses the same validation engine as AI Defense, along with an Agent Runtime SDK and an LLM security leaderboard. Role-based access control requires the enterprise edition, according to the release. Cisco Newsroom (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-20, opens in new tab)

  7. 2026-03-02 · outage Cisco Systems, Inc.
    Cisco Secure Access Dubai data centre incident forces customers to move to India regions

    Disclosed by Cisco on its Secure Access status page and in a support note: an incident at its Dubai data centre began on 2026-03-02. Resource connectors in the region showed as disconnected and remote access VPN clients could fail to connect. Cisco redirected roaming traffic to Mumbai and told customers to deploy new connectors and move VPN profiles and network tunnels to its India regions; web gateway and zero-trust clients moved to the next closest data centre automatically. Cisco gave no cause in the pages read, and its status page still showed the Middle East (UAE) region as degraded on 2026-11-21.   15. 2018-10-01 · acquisition Cisco Systems, Inc.
    Cisco completes its acquisition of Duo Security for US$2.35 billion

    Cisco announced on 2018-10-01 that it had completed the acquisition of Duo Security, a privately held provider of multi-factor authentication and access security based in Ann Arbor, Michigan, for US$2.35 billion in cash and assumed equity awards. Duo's team joined Cisco's networking and security business. Recorded because it changed ownership of the product; Duo Security is not tracked as a separate vendor in this dataset.
